facts.text: SLS Barcelona is set on the marina at Port Fòrum, steps from the beach.
facts.excerpt: SLS Barcelona is set on the marina at Port Fòrum, steps from the beach

facts.text: Guests can charter catamarans and private boats from Port Fòrum.
facts.excerpt: guests of SLS Barcelona can charter catamarans and private boats from Port Fòrum

facts.text: A neighbourhood beach is a five-minute stroll from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: A tranquil neighbourhood beach known only to locals and insiders is a five-minute stroll away

facts.text: The Parc del Fòrum, where the Primavera Sound festival is held, is a few steps from the hotel, and the hotel is an official partner of the festival.
facts.excerpt: The Parc del Fòrum, where the popular Primavera Sound festival is held (the hotel is an official partner), is also just a few steps away.

facts.text: The International Barcelona Convention Centre (CCIB) is a short walk from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: with the hotel offering a stylish base only a short walk away

facts.text: Every room and suite has a balcony or terrace, and many have views of the marina and the Mediterranean.
facts.excerpt: The ultimate VIP stay begins with luxe rooms and suites, each featuring a balcony or terrace, many offering views of the marina and the glittering Mediterranean Sea.

facts.text: The Delight King Pool Access room is on the ground floor with direct access to the pool from its patio.
facts.excerpt: This ground floor room provides access to the vibrant SLS pool scene directly from its patio.

facts.text: The Euphoria Apartment has a kitchenette with stove, oven, microwave and mini-fridge.
facts.excerpt: Perfect for longer stays, this apartment features a kitchenette with stove, oven, microwave and mini-fridge.

facts.text: The Celestial Suite is the hotel's largest suite and terrace.
facts.excerpt: The resort's largest suite and terrace also boast the most breathtaking design and views.

facts.text: A pet kit is available in rooms on request.
facts.excerpt: Pet-Kit (Available Upon Request)

facts.text: The ground-level Coral pool is open year-round, with a boardwalk setting.
facts.excerpt: At ground level, Coral remains open year-round, with its boardwalk setting and laid-back Mediterranean atmosphere.

facts.text: Coral is inspired by the summers of Miami's South Beach.
facts.excerpt: Coral is inspired by the iconic summers of Miami

facts.text: Coral is a family-friendly pool.
facts.excerpt: Relax by the family-friendly pool, enjoy refreshing drinks and casual dining

facts.text: The two rooftop infinity pools offer sea and city views during the summer season.
facts.excerpt: Two rooftop infinity pools offer panoramic sea and city views during the summer season

facts.text: Halcyon Spa has an immersive jacuzzi where cinematic visuals surround the space and a rain shower falls from above.
facts.excerpt: Cinematic visuals surround the space as jets move through the jacuzzi and a gentle rain shower falls from above

facts.text: Guests who book a spa treatment get 90 minutes of access to the Halcyon facilities.
facts.excerpt: Guests who have booked a treatment at the spa will enjoy 90 minutes of access to Halcyon facilities

facts.text: The Halcyon spa has a heated lounge centred on a heated circular moonstone platform.
facts.excerpt: A sculptural space centered around a heated circular moonstone platform.

facts.text: Halcyon spa products include Sepai, APOEM and Ideal Form.
facts.excerpt: include Sepai, APOEM, and Ideal Form® among others

facts.text: The hotel has a light-filled waterfront gym open 24/7.
facts.excerpt: the expansive, light-filled, waterfront, 24/7 gym

facts.text: Cosmico is a rooftop pool club and restaurant with a Japanese-inspired menu, cocktails and DJ sessions.
facts.excerpt: Rooftop pool club & restaurant featuring Japanese-inspired menu, panoramic views, cocktails & DJ sessions.

facts.text: Deluxe, in the lobby, changes from a café by day to a lounge bar at night.
facts.excerpt: From morning to night, Deluxe transforms from a vibrant café to a sleek lounge bar.

facts.text: Lora, off the lobby, serves cuisine inspired by the Mediterranean coast.
facts.excerpt: Located off of the lobby, Lora takes you on a journey along the Mediterranean coast

facts.text: Kyara is a post-modern cocktail bar on the hotel's fifth floor.
facts.excerpt: A post-modern cocktail bar, hidden inside the 5th floor of SLS Barcelona.

facts.text: Kyara is the first project in Spain from mixologists Monica Berg and Alex Kratena.
facts.excerpt: The famous mixology duo Monica Berg and Alex Kratena have launched their first project in Spain

facts.text: Coral is the only restaurant at the hotel that is exclusively for hotel guests.
facts.excerpt: Coral is the only restaurant at the SLS that is exclusively for hotel guests.

facts.text: SLS Barcelona is the first European hotel from the SLS brand.
facts.excerpt: The first European outpost from the SLS brand promises everything, and it delivers.

facts.text: The building was designed by b720 Fermín Vázquez Arquitectos.
facts.excerpt: the design by b720 Fermín Vázquez Arquitectos

facts.text: A pink neon-lit hallway in the lobby leads to the port.
facts.excerpt: In the lobby, your eyes will be drawn to the pink neon lights that illuminate what looks like a path guiding Alice to Wonderland (it actually leads to the port).

facts.text: Monkeys are hidden throughout the hotel's decor, in paintings, decorative elements and lamps.
facts.excerpt: Finding the monkeys hidden in the SLS Barcelona

facts.text: The whole hotel was designed to be accessible to guests with limited mobility.
facts.excerpt: All of the hotel was designed to be accessible to guests with limited mobility.

facts.text: The hotel uses room keys made from recycled wood.
facts.excerpt: using keys made from recycled wood

facts.text: SLS Barcelona is a five-star waterfront resort.
facts.excerpt: Welcome to SLS Barcelona, a five-star waterfront resort
